meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动做成一集讲解视频,讲清改了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要向非技术的同事解释改了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a short explainer video of what changed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N 或已 checkout 仓库里的「this PR」)做成一份代码改动讲解视频:从 diff、commit、文件出发,经分镜、脚本、音频逐帧生成 HTML,最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 链接、「owner/repo#N」,或在已 checkout 的仓库里说「this PR」时,它接管并把该改动做成讲解视频。产品推广或无 PR 的选题解释不走这里,会先去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成讲解视频:acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 从该 PR 的 diff 和 commit 生成视频。

say.text: 用 this PR 做一条重构走查视频
say.note: 在已 checkout 的仓库里读取当前 PR。

say.text: 这个 PR 视频用男声配音
say.note: 需在音频步骤传入对应的 voice id。

howto.what_en: Reads a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR") and builds a code-change explainer video from its diff, commits, and files — storyboard, script, audio, frames, then renders video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL or owner/repo#N, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Product promos or no-PR topic explainers go to /hyperframes instead.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Builds the video from that PR's diff and commits.

say_en.text: Make a refactor walkthrough from this PR
say_en.note: Reads the current PR in a checked-out repo.

say_en.text: Narrate this PR video with a male voice
say_en.note: Pass a matching voice id at the audio step.
